Lurt 0.8.9 lets you drag tabs and favourites into the order you want, and fixes Discord's icon.

**Download Lurt:** [Windows (Lurt.exe)](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.9/Lurt.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.9/Lurt.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 already include.

## Changed

- **Volume without the blur.** The tab volume mixer opens over the live page, which keeps playing sharp behind it.
- **Lurt.exe.** The program is now named with a capital L.

## New

- **Drag your favourites.** Reorder the sites on the start page. A most-visited site you move becomes a favourite and stays there.

## Fixed

- **Tab dragging.** Tabs with a website in them can be reordered too, not only empty ones.
- **Site icons.** Discord and other sites that only give their icon to their own pages now show it, after you open the site once.
